original_ai_output.title_zh: 肯尼亚报告第二例埃博拉病例，为首例患者家属
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 肯尼亚卫生部周三表示，该国录得第二例埃博拉病例，距其首次报告埃博拉病例及死亡病例仅一周多。第二例患者为39岁男性，是首例病例的密切家属，在隔离期间于周二出现症状。首例患者曾赴刚果（金）患病，经陆路进入乌干达后于10月3日飞抵内罗毕，10月5日在内罗毕一家医院死亡。该病例引发对该地区边境筛查的担忧，因患者得以从刚果（金）进入乌干达，而该边境自5月以来一直关闭。

key_facts.fact: 肯尼亚报告第二例埃博拉病例
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Kenya reported a second case of Ebola on Wednesday, a week after confirming its first-ever infection linked to the outbreak in neighbouring Democratic Republic of Congo.

key_facts.fact: 第二例患者为39岁男性，是首例病例的密切家属，隔离期间出现症状
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The second patient, a 39-year-old man and close family member of the first case, was already in quarantine when he developed symptoms on Tuesday, the health ministry said.

key_facts.fact: 首例患者经陆路进入乌干达后飞抵内罗毕，于10月5日在内罗毕医院死亡
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The first patient, a Kenyan man who had been ill in Congo, travelled by road to Uganda before flying to Nairobi on October 3. He died in a Nairobi hospital on October 5.

key_facts.fact: 患者得以从刚果（金）进入乌干达，而该边境自5月以来一直关闭，引发对地区边境筛查的担忧
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The case has raised concerns about border screening in the region, as the patient was able to cross from Congo into Uganda despite the border having been closed since May.

uncertainties: 该事件目前为单一来源报道，尚缺乏交叉验证
第二例病例的感染来源及传播链尚未完全确认
